answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 196 aliases means carrying 107 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The vine escrow is released only against a comet receipt, and the lotus audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 25 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
